We agree: “Living while black is not a crime. But making a false report, especially motivated by hate, should be." https://t.co/rsd1cZhbMo #BlackLivesMatter
"How in the world does the security guard get shot by the police?" Many already know the answer. https://t.co/ja9pEL113p #JemelRoberson #BLACKLIVESMATTER

Hopefully @kennedystewart you will take action on this and (1) listen and (2) implement change based on what was said. Don't let this issue end with a meeting. That has been the MO of politicians historically (meetings and no action); now is your chance to lead #BlackLivesMatter

"The thing with activism is that it doesn’t build character, it reveals character – and people have so much more to offer than what the world tells them" https://t.co/jpiiDKZG9Z @janaya_khan #BlackLivesMatter #TransLivesMatter

"This is a state of emergency. | We are told that we do not matter. | We are dehumanized... In a society that is predicated on anti-Black racism, vulnerability is not recognized on the bodies and in the experiences of Black people."  https://t.co/chI7QmK5hm #BlackLivesMatter
For #FF here is the account to follow: 👉 @NoPolicing 👈  https://t.co/uwsoHVAKdN #NoPridePolice #PrideTO #BlackLivesMatter
